description: Feedback-free DDMv3 baseline, frozen before adding spread_feedback. All numbers transcribed from this session's actual script output, not recomputed.

ordinal_correspondence.description: Spearman(stat, delta) on DDM side vs Spearman(stat, quantile) on real side -- from regime_atlas_comparison.py, long (1000-row) characterization window version

windowed_future_volatility_correlation.description: Spearman(quantile, windowed future vol at t+h) -- ddm_horizon_analysis.py section A

cumulative_return_std_ratio.description: DDM/Real ratio of cumulative-return std, t -> t+h -- ddm_horizon_analysis.py section B

interval_coverage_pooled.description: Empirical coverage %, DDM ensemble's [lo,hi] percentile interval vs nominal level, pooled across all 20 quantiles -- ddm_calibration_check.py section A

per_quantile_90pct_coverage.description: Per-quantile empirical coverage %% of the DDM ensemble's 90% (5th-95th percentile) interval -- ddm_calibration_check.py section A2

tail_probability_h24.description: Predicted (DDM ensemble) vs realized frequency (%) of |cumulative return| exceeding real-data percentile thresholds, horizon=24 windows -- ddm_calibration_check.py section B

per_quantile.note: rows are [pred_p50, real_p50, pred_p70, real_p70, pred_p85, real_p85, pred_p95, real_p95], indexed by quantile 0-19

ensemble_candidates_used.description: delta/wma per quantile as selected by ddm_ensemble_selection.py -- reused as-is for the spread-feedback experiment, not re-derived
ensemble_candidates_used.note: Full 8-candidate sets per quantile live in ddm_regime_atlas.csv + ddm_ensemble_selection.py's own selection logic; representative best-match points from that run
